title: ESA’s Hera spacecraft is flying rectangles around NASA’s asteroid crash site
caption:
ESA’s Hera spacecraft has reached the site of NASA’s 2022 asteroid impact. It’s flying in unique rectangular patterns to study the aftermath and help us prepare for future planetary defense.

Source: Sciencedaily - ESA’s Hera spacecraft is flying rectangles around NASA’s asteroid crash site
